San Telmo, the oldest neighborhood in Buenos Aires, is a living museum of cobblestone streets, 19th-century colonial architecture, tango roots, and vibrant local markets. Whether you are looking for a guided excursion, a free walking tour, or a self-guided route, here is a breakdown of the best ways to experience a historical walk through San Telmo.

evidence.title: Two to Tango: A San Telmo Self Guided Walking Tour
evidence.snippet: San Telmo is the oldest neighbourhood in Buenos Aires, and its cobblestone streets hold enough history to fill several lifetimes. On this self-guided walking tour, you'll trace how sailors, slaves, immigrants, and tango singers turned a muddy colonial outpost into the soul of the city. You'll also discover how a yellow fever epidemic, two British invasions, and millions of Italian immigrants each left their mark on this single neighbourhood. evidence.title: Beyond Caminito \u0026 San Telmo: Hidden Stories of Buenos Aires
evidence.snippet: San Telmo is the oldest neigborhood in Buenos Aires, the place where it was foundated the city in 1536 and 1580. The architecture reminds the spanish colonial style (they're houses of 400 years!) and this makes a contrast with the ''Paris'' cultural imagination that we have of Buenos Aires. Tango, artisans and all the history in the colonial time is what San Telmo have, an unique place to enjoy the past and the beauty of their narrow streets. evidence.title: Private La Boca and San Telmo History Walk
evidence.snippet: Join our La Boca + San Telmo History Walk to explore the heart of Buenos Aires' rich history and culture. Starting in San Telmo, known for cobbled streets, immigrant architecture, and a vibrant food scene, we begin with a mate-tasting experience in a centennial building. Then, visit the historic San Telmo Market, offering ethnic foods, fresh produce, and unique trinkets. Next, discover La Boca, the port where European immigrants arrived, shaping the city forever. evidence.title: San Telmo Colonial Walking Tour – Buenos Aires History
evidence.snippet: Discover the colonial history of Buenos Aires and Argentina on a guided San Telmo walking tour. Explore the city's transformation from a small village to a cosmopolitan hub, with engaging stories about its foundation, native peoples, invasions, and independence.
